normative_extracts.quote: When a user agent is to reestablish the connection, it must set the Last-Event-ID header to the last event ID string and wait the reconnection time.

pipeline_phases: HTTP/2 SSE or WebSocket Frame Ingress
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Stream-backed transports propagate consumer desiredSize back to the OS socket buffer, while full-jitter exponential backoff decorrelates client reconnects across a bounded random window.

production_failures.symptom: Origin server CPU spikes to 100% immediately after a brief load-balancer restart
production_failures.root_cause: Clients reconnect using deterministic intervals or unjittered exponential backoff, creating synchronized retry waves.
production_failures.mitigation: Apply full-jitter backoff: Math.random() * Math.min(capMs, baseMs * 2 ** attempt) with AbortSignal cancellation.

production_failures.symptom: Browser tab OOMs during high-throughput market or telemetry bursts
production_failures.root_cause: Legacy WebSocket.onmessage pushes frames faster than the main thread renders, growing JS queues without TCP backpressure.
production_failures.mitigation: Consume frames through a ReadableStream (WebSocketStream or fetch stream) so paused reads throttle the socket.
